40022395.author: पदार्थः
40022395.content: तथा thus, तु indeed, करुणं piteous, तस्य his, द्विजस्य of the brahmin, परिदेवनम् lamentation, शुश्राव heard, राघवः Rama, सर्वं all, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् filled with sorrow and grief.

40022395.author: Translation
40022395.content: Rama heard the entire piteous lamentation of that brahmin, which was filled with sorrow and grief.

40022396.author: पदार्थः
40022396.content: सः He, दुःखेन by sorrow, च and, सन्तप्तो distressed, मन्त्रिणः ministers, तान् those, उपाह्वयत् summoned, वसिष्ठं Vasistha, वामदेवं Vamadeva, च and, भ्रातरौ his two brothers, सह along with, नैगमान् the citizens/merchants.

40022396.author: Translation
40022396.content: Distressed by sorrow, Rama summoned his ministers, along with Vasistha, Vamadeva, his two brothers, and the representatives of the city.

40022397.author: पदार्थः
40022397.content: ततः then, द्विजाः brahmins, वसिष्ठेन by Vasistha, सार्धम् together with, अष्टौ eight, प्रवेशिताः were ushered in, राजानं the king, देवसङ्काशं god-like, वर्धस्व may you prosper, इति thus, ततः then, अब्रुवन् they said.

40022397.author: Translation
40022397.content: Then, eight brahmins, accompanied by Vasistha, were ushered in and, seeing the god-like king, they blessed him saying, "May you prosper!"

40022398.author: पदार्थः
40022398.content: मार्कण्डेयः Markandeya, अथ and, मौद्गल्यः Maudgalya, वामदेवः Vamadeva, च and, काश्यपः Kashyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, अथ and, जाबालिः Jabali, गौतमः Gautama, नारदः Narada, तथा and also, एते these, द्विजर्षभाः best of brahmins, सर्वे all, आसनेषु on seats, उपवेशिताः were seated.

40022398.author: Translation
40022398.content: Markandeya, Maudgalya, Vamadeva, Kashyapa, Katyayana, Jabali, Gautama, and Narada—all these eminent brahmins were seated on their respective seats.

40022399.author: पदार्थः
40022399.content: महर्षीन् the great sages, समनुप्राप्तान् who had arrived, अभिवाद्य having saluted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, नैगमान् the citizens/merchants, च and, एव also, यथार्हम् appropriately, अनुकूलतः respectfully.

40022399.author: Translation
40022399.content: With folded hands, Rama respectfully saluted the arrived great sages, as well as the ministers and citizens, each according to their due.

40022400.author: पदार्थः
40022400.content: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, सर्वेषां of all, दीप्ततेजसाम् of shining splendor, राघवः Rama, सर्वम् everything, आचष्टे narrated, अयम् this, द्विजः brahmin, उपरोधते obstructs.

40022400.author: Translation
40022400.content: Rama narrated everything to all those seated sages of shining splendor, explaining that this brahmin's situation was causing a hindrance.

40022401.author: पदार्थः
40022401.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राज्ञः of the king, दीनस्य distressed, नारदः Narada, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभं auspicious, वाक्यम् words, ऋषीणां of the sages, सन्निधौ in the presence, नृपम् to the king.

40022401.author: Translation
40022401.content: Having heard the distressed king's words, Narada replied with auspicious words to the king in the presence of the sages.

40022402.author: पदार्थः
40022402.content: शृणु listen, राजन् O King, यथाकाले in due course, प्राप्तः occurred, बालस्य of the child, सङ्क्षयः the death, श्रुत्वा having heard, कर्तव्यतां what is to be done, राजन् O King, कुरुष्व perform, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022402.author: Translation
40022402.content: O King, O Rama, listen to how the child's death occurred in due course, and having heard what is to be done, perform your duty.

40022403.author: पदार्थः
40022403.content: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राजन् O King, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, वै indeed, तपस्विनः were ascetics, अब्राह्मणः a non-brahmin, तदा then, राजन् O King, न not, तपस्वी an ascetic, कथञ्चन by any means.

40022403.author: Translation
40022403.content: O King, in the ancient Krita Yuga, only brahmins were ascetics, and no non-brahmin was an ascetic by any means.

40022404.author: पदार्थः
40022404.content: तस्मिन् in that, युगे age, प्रज्वलिते shining brightly, ब्रह्मभूते divine, तु and, अनावृते unobstructed, अमृत्युवः immortal, तदा then, सर्वे all, जज्ञिरे were born, दीर्घदर्शिनः far-seeing.

40022404.author: Translation
40022404.content: In that resplendent, divine, and unobstructed age, all beings were born immortal and far-seeing.

40022405.author: पदार्थः
40022405.content: ततः thereafter, त्रेतायुगं Treta Yuga, नाम named, मानवानां of humans, वपुष्मताम् embodied, क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, तत्र there, जायन्ते are born, पूर्णेन with complete, तपसा penance, अन्विताः endowed with,

40022405.author: Translation
40022405.content: Thereafter, in the age named Treta Yuga, embodied humans, specifically Kshatriyas, were born endowed with complete penance.

40022406.author: पदार्थः
40022406.content: वीर्येण by valor, तपसा by penance, च and, एव indeed, ते they, अधिकाः superior, पूर्वजन्मनि in previous birth, मानवाः humans, ये who, महात्मानः great-souled ones, तु indeed, अत्र here, त्रेतायुगे in Treta Yuga, युगे in the age,

40022406.author: Translation
40022406.content: Those great-souled humans who were superior in valor and penance in their previous birth were indeed born in this Treta Yuga.

40022407.author: पदार्थः
40022407.content: ब्रह्मक्षत्रं Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, च and, तत् that, सर्वं all, यत् which, पूर्वं earlier, अपरं later, च and, यत् which, युगयोः of the two ages, उभयोः of both, आसीत् was, समवीर्यसमन्वितम् endowed with equal valor,

40022407.author: Translation
40022407.content: All those Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, both the former and the latter, were endowed with equal valor in both ages.

40022408.author: पदार्थः
40022408.content: अपश्यन्तः not seeing, तु but, न not, ते they, सर्वे all, विशेषं distinction, अधिकं greater, ततः from that, स्थापनं establishment, चक्रिरे they made, तत्र there, चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य of the four varnas, सम्मतम् approved,

40022408.author: Translation
40022408.content: Not seeing any greater distinction among them, all of them then established the approved system of four varnas.

40022409.author: पदार्थः
40022409.content: तस्मिन् in that, युगे age, प्रज्वलिते shining brightly, धर्मभूते full of dharma, हि indeed, अनावृते unobstructed, अधर्मः unrighteousness, पादं foot, एकं one, तु indeed, पातयत् cast down, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth,

40022409.author: Translation
40022409.content: In that brightly shining age, which was indeed full of unobstructed dharma, unrighteousness nevertheless placed one foot upon the surface of the earth.

40022410.author: पदार्थः
40022410.content: अधर्मेण by unrighteousness, हि indeed, संयुक्तः joined, तेजः splendor, मन्दम् diminished, भविष्यति will become.

40022410.author: Translation
40022410.content: Indeed, one who is associated with unrighteousness will find their splendor diminished.

40022411.author: पदार्थः
40022411.content: आमिषम् desire, यत् which, च and, पूर्वेषाम् of the ancients, राजसम् passionate, च and, मलम् impurity, भृशम् exceedingly, अनृतम् untruth, नाम named, तत् that, भूतम् being, पादेन by a foot, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth.

40022411.author: Translation
40022411.content: That which was the object of desire for the ancients and a great passionate impurity, that very being named Untruth, manifested on the earth with one foot.

40022412.author: पदार्थः
40022412.content: अनृतम् untruth, पातयित्वा having caused to fall, तु indeed, पादम् foot, एकम् one, अधर्मतः from unrighteousness, ततः then, प्रादुष्कृतम् manifested, पूर्वम् formerly, आयुषः of life, परिनिष्ठितम् determined.

40022412.author: Translation
40022412.content: Indeed, when untruth caused one foot of Dharma to fall due to unrighteousness, then the duration of life was previously determined and established.

40022413.author: पदार्थः
40022413.content: पतिते having descended, तु indeed, अनृते untruth, तस्मिन् that, अधर्मे unrighteousness, च and, महीतले on the surface of the earth, शुभानि auspicious things, एव only, आचरन् performing, लोकः people, सत्यधर्मपरायणः devoted to truth and righteousness.

40022413.author: Translation
40022413.content: Indeed, even when that untruth and unrighteousness had descended upon the earth, people devoted to truth and righteousness still performed only auspicious deeds.

40022414.author: पदार्थः
40022414.content: त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, च and, वर्तन्ते existed, ब्राह्मणाः Brahmins, क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, च and, ये who, तपः penance, अतप्यन्त performed, ते they, सर्वे all, शुश्रूषाम् service, अपरे others, जनाः people.

40022414.author: Translation
40022414.content: In the Treta Yuga, all those Brahmins and Kshatriyas who existed performed penance, while other people performed service.

40022415.author: पदार्थः
40022415.content: स that, धर्मः righteousness, परमः supreme, तेषाम् of them, वैश्यशूद्रम् to the Vaiśyas and Śūdras, समागमत् reached, पूजां worship, च and, सर्ववर्णानाम् of all castes, शूद्राः Śūdras, चक्रुः performed, विशेषतः especially.

40022415.author: Translation
40022415.content: That supreme righteousness, which was previously universal, now reached the Vaiśyas and Śūdras, and the Śūdras, in particular, began to perform worship for all castes.

40022416.author: पदार्थः
40022416.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, तेषाम् of them, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, च and, अनृते in falsehood, च and, ह indeed, ततः then, पूर्वे the former (righteousness), भृशम् greatly, ह्रासम् diminution, अगमन् underwent, नृपसत्तम O best of kings.

40022416.author: Translation
40022416.content: O best of kings, in this interval, as unrighteousness and falsehood increased among the people, the former state of righteousness greatly diminished.

40022417.author: पदार्थः
40022417.content: ततः then, पादम् a quarter, अधर्मः unrighteousness, सः that, द्वितीयम् second, अवतारयत् manifested, ततः then, द्वापरसञ्ज्ञा the name Dvāpara, अस्य of this, युगस्य of the age, समजायत arose.

40022417.author: Translation
40022417.content: Then, unrighteousness manifested its second quarter, and consequently, this age came to be known as Dvāpara.

40022418.author: पदार्थः
40022418.content: तस्मिन् in that, द्वापरसञ्ज्ञे named Dvāpara, तु indeed, वर्तमाने prevailing, युगक्षये in the decline of the age, अधर्मः unrighteousness, च and, अनृतम् falsehood, च and, एव indeed, ववृधे increased, पुरुषर्षभ O best of men.

40022418.author: Translation
40022418.content: O best of men, during the prevailing Dvāpara age, which marked a decline, both unrighteousness and falsehood greatly increased.

40022419.author: पदार्थः
40022419.content: तस्मिन् in that, द्वापरसङ्ख्याते designated as Dvāpara, तपः austerity, वैश्यान् the Vaiśyas, समाविशत् entered, त्रिभ्यः from three, युगेभ्यः ages, त्रीन् three, वर्णान् castes, क्रमात् successively, वै indeed, तपः austerity, आविशत् entered.

40022419.author: Translation
40022419.content: In that age designated as Dvāpara, austerity entered the Vaiśyas, as indeed, austerity successively entered the three castes over the course of the three ages (Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara).

40022420.author: पदार्थः
40022420.content: त्रिभ्यो from three, युगेभ्यः ages (Yugas), त्रीन् three, वर्णान् castes/classes, धर्मः righteousness/duty, च and, परिनिष्ठितः established/fixed. न not, शुद्धः a Shudra, लभते obtains/gets, धर्मम् religious merit/duty, युगतः according to the age, तु but, नरर्षभ O best among men (Rama). हीनवर्णः a person of lower caste, नृपश्रेष्ठ O best of kings (Rama), तप्यते performs penance, सुमहत् very great, तपः penance.

40022420.author: Translation
40022420.content: For the three ages (Krita, Treta, Dvapara), dharma is established for the three higher varnas, and a Shudra does not obtain religious merit by performing penance in these ages; yet, O best of kings, a person of lower caste is performing very great penance.

40022421.author: पदार्थः
40022421.content: भविष्यत् will be, शूद्रयोन्याम् in the Shudra caste, वै indeed, तपश्चर्या performance of penance, कलौ in the Kali, युगे age. अधर्मः unrighteousness, परमः supreme/greatest, राजन् O King, द्वापरे in the Dvapara, शूद्रजन्मनः for one born as a Shudra.

40022421.author: Translation
40022421.content: Indeed, the performance of penance by a Shudra will be permissible in the Kali Yuga, but in the Dvapara Yuga, O King, it is the greatest unrighteousness for one born as a Shudra.

40022422.author: पदार्थः
40022422.content: सः that (person), वै indeed, विषयपर्यन्ते at the border of your kingdom, तव your, राजन् O King, महातपाः great ascetic. अद्य today, तप्यति performs penance, दुर्बुद्धिः evil-minded/foolish, तेन by that, बालवधः child's death, हि indeed, अयम् this.

40022422.author: Translation
40022422.content: That very great ascetic, O King, is indeed performing penance today at the border of your kingdom, and it is by this foolish act that this child's death has occurred.

40022423.author: पदार्थः
40022423.content: यः who, हि indeed, अधर्मम् unrighteousness, अकार्यम् improper act, वा or, विषये in the kingdom, पार्थिवस्य of the king, तु but. करोति does, च and, अश्रीमूलम् root of misfortune, तत्पुरे in his city, वा or, दुर्मतिः evil-minded, नरः man. क्षिप्रम् quickly, च and, नरकम् to hell, याति goes, सः he, च and, राजा the king, न no, संशयः doubt.

40022423.author: Translation
40022423.content: Indeed, any evil-minded person who commits unrighteousness or an improper act, which is the root of misfortune, in the king's kingdom or city, quickly goes to hell, and so does the king, without a doubt.

40022424.author: पदार्थः
40022424.content: अधीतस्य of what is studied (Vedas), च and, तप्तस्य of what is performed (penance), कर्मणः of action, सुकृतस्य of good deeds, च and. षष्ठम् sixth, भजति obtains/enjoys, भागम् share, तु but, प्रजाः subjects, धर्मेण righteously, पालयन् protecting/governing.

40022424.author: Translation
40022424.content: A king who protects his subjects righteously obtains a sixth share of the merit from their Vedic studies, penance, and good deeds.

40022425.author: पदार्थः
40022425.content: षङ्भागस्य of the sixth part, न not, भोक्ता enjoyer, असौ he, रक्षते protects, न not, प्रजाः subjects, कथम् how

40022425.author: Translation
40022425.content: How can a king who does not protect his subjects be entitled to receive the sixth part of their produce as tax?

40022426.author: पदार्थः
40022426.content: स that, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, मार्गस्व search, विषयं realm, स्वकम् your own, दुष्कृतं evil deed, यत्र where, पश्येथाः you might see, तत्र there, यत्नं effort, समाचर undertake

40022426.author: Translation
40022426.content: O tiger among men, you should search your own kingdom, and wherever you find an evil deed, there you must make an effort to rectify it.

40022427.author: पदार्थः
40022427.content: एवं thus, चेत् if, धर्मवृद्धिश्च and increase of righteousness, नृणां of men, च and, आयुर्विवर्धनम् increase of life span, भविष्यति will be, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, बालस्य of the child, अस्य this, च and, जीवितम् life

40022427.author: Translation
40022427.content: O best of men, if this is done, there will be an increase in righteousness and the lifespan of men, and this child's life will also be restored. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुःसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 74 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
